COMMAND LIST & CONTROLS

PLAYER 1 (Default)

  • A / D : Move (Double tap to Dash)
  • W : Jump
  • S : Crouch / Low Guard
  • J : Light Punch (LP)
  • K : Heavy Punch (HP)
  • U : Light Kick (LK)
  • I : Heavy Kick (HK)
  • O : Special 1 (Fireball / Surge / Shuriken / Lightning)
  • L : Special 2 (Dragon Ascent / Flash Blade / Shadow Step / Divekick)
  • SPACE : SUPER MOVE (Requires 100% EX)

PLAYER 2 (Local PvP)

  • ◄ / ► : Move (Double tap to Dash)
  • ▲ : Jump
  • ▼ : Crouch / Low Guard
  • Numpad 1 : Light Punch
  • Numpad 2 : Heavy Punch
  • Numpad 4 : Light Kick
  • Numpad 5 : Heavy Kick
  • Numpad 6 : Special 1
  • Numpad 3 : Special 2
  • Enter : SUPER MOVE

FIGHTING MECHANICS

Blocking: Hold Back (A when facing right) to high-block. Hold Down-Back (S+A) to crouch-block sweeps!

Gatling Combos & Cancels: Chain Light ➔ Heavy ➔ Special ➔ Super on hit or block for ultra-fast, seamless combos!

Gamepads: Full Gamepad support! Plug in Xbox/PlayStation controllers at any time.
